data.name: AboutDescription
data.value: Free, open-source scanner for barcodes, QR codes and NFC tags. It reads everything IBE Barcode Generator prints, needs no database, and sends nothing off the device.

data.name: AboutCoverageText
data.value: Camera: Codabar, Code 39 and Extended Code 39, Code 93, Code 128, GS1-128, Interleaved 2 of 5, EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC-A, UPC-E, UPC supplements, ISBN, QR Code, Data Matrix, PDF417, Aztec, plus MSI Plessey and USPS Postnet from a captured frame. NFC: NDEF tags containing a link, text, email address, phone number or WiFi credentials.

data.name: AboutLimitationsText
data.value: NFC reading on iPhone needs an Apple Developer entitlement and is not in this version. MSI Plessey and USPS Postnet are decoded from a captured frame, so they need a steady, well-lit label rather than a long-distance scan. Android scanning uses Google ML Kit, which requires Google Play services.

data.name: AboutCompanion
data.value: Companion of IBE Barcode Generator. Printed formats are verified against it.

data.name: HelpScanText
data.value: Point the camera at the label and tap Scan. The app takes a picture of what the camera sees and reads it; nothing is decoded until you press. If nothing is found, the warning disappears by itself and you can tap Scan again.

data.name: HelpPhotoTitle
data.value: Read a barcode from a photo

data.name: HelpPhotoText
data.value: Tap Scan a photo to read a code from a picture already on the phone. Useful for a label that has been photographed, or one that is hard to hold steady.

data.name: HelpResultText
data.value: The result shows the value and its format. Tap the value to look it up on the web. If the code carries a link, the link is shown underneath: tap it to open it in the browser. Copy and Share pass the value on.

data.name: HelpNfcText
data.value: On the NFC tab, tap Start NFC scan and hold the top of the phone against the tag. A tag tapped against the phone can also open the app directly.

data.name: HelpTipsText
data.value: The light button turns the torch on for dark labels, and Switch camera flips between the rear and front cameras. Scans stay in History until the app closes, on this phone only, and nothing is uploaded.
